en: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song.

zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，又是愛慕歌，交與伶長。調用百合花。

ja: 指揮者のために。「ゆり」に合わせて。コラの子らによる黙想の詩。結婚の歌。

p.src: 1  My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

ja: は気高い主題であふれている。
のために詩を朗読する。
en: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

ja: く。 公正の笏が、あなたの

ja: は、仲間たちにまさって
en: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
